After the trials of rooting, seeding and shooting,
After the gathering of energy for budding and fruiting,
Out toward the sun returns the petals flush
Before sweet perfumes and flavours back to nature rush
To make the mother, in all guises at, her own loving blush,
Before recruiting the trust of the hush,
Pause  
Before life returns to nourish the poietic dust
